dedupe_keys.name: cambridge university estates building energy usage archive

description: Max Langtry and Ruchi Choudhary publish electricity and gas metering from anonymised buildings across Cambridge University Estates for 2000–2023. Version 2.1, archived in May 2024, includes hourly CSVs aggregated from half-hourly readings and tools for preparing CityLearn datasets. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0; the code repository also carries MIT terms. Downloads are free, with upstream weather and auxiliary inputs retaining their own conditions. These observations can calibrate building-demand or demand-response simulations. Missing or invalid meter values become zero, extreme readings are clipped, and building identifiers changed between versions one and two. Auxiliary tariffs repeat 2019–2022 cyclically, photovoltaic generation is modelled, and forecast fields are perfect copies of observations. Related catalogue record data-citylearn-environment-and-datasets describes the target environment. Those assumptions create uncertainty and prevent treating every column as independent historical measurement. Files and control experiments were not executed.
